target_customer: Consumers managing chronic conditions who want their records and wearable data in one assistant
problem: Patients wait weeks for care team replies and face fragmented records; generic health searches ignore their own history.
business_model: Consumer app (beta) with no stated pricing

founders.name: Viraj Mehta
education: Stanford, BS and MS in computer science and AI
founders.background_notes: Built Galen from his own chronic back pain experience

founders.name: Priyanka Shrestha
education: Stanford, BS and MS in computer science and AI

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting records from 800 institutions and 20 wearables via aggregation networks plus LLM memory is integration heavy, but built on existing health data APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Consumer LLM wrappers over health data were easy to copy, and OpenAI launched ChatGPT Health in January 2026 with similar record linking.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Oura acquired the team and technology on April 17, 2026; OpenAI launched ChatGPT Health in January 2026.

market_need_then: The company cited about 1 billion health related Google searches daily with impersonal answers, and the founder's own multi year struggle with chronic back pain.

branding.domain_note: galenai.com, an AI suffix domain; site returned 404 when fetched

identity.voice_and_tone: Personal, empathetic founder story: 'Hey, I'm Viraj'

brand_strength.rationale: Name echoes the ancient physician, a plausible but unsourced choice, and is shared with a robotics firm and other Galen AI products; coverage of the brand itself was not found.

outcome_analysis: Galen AI joined YC in Spring 2025 with two Stanford founders and a beta health companion linking medical and wearable data. Oura announced on April 17, 2026 that it acquired the technology and the team, following its purchases of Doublepoint and Veri; terms are undisclosed and the app's future is not stated. With a small round and a crowding field after ChatGPT Health, this reads as a talent and technology acquisition.
notes: Company website returned 404. A $500K round in June 2025 appears only on two aggregators with conflicting labels (seed with angels, versus pre seed with YC), so it is not recorded as a round. Acquisition confirmed by Oura's blog and trade press. No dated competitors near April 2025 were retrieved (the ChatGPT Health result is January 2026), so the list is empty. Acquihire factor is an inference.
